assay: bulk RNA-seq, plantaris muscle, old (23-24 mo) male C57BL/6J mice (S2.8.p1, S2.2.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of senolytic D+Q (vs vehicle) on the plantaris transcriptome of old mice after 14 days of synergist-ablation mechanical overload (MOV, the paper's resistance-exercise model) (S2.8.p1, S3.5.p1)
sample_inclusion: Paper RNA-seq: vehicle- and D+Q-treated old mice, 14 d MOV, n=5/group (S2.8.p1; FIG6 N=5/group). GEO also deposits sham-operated vehicle and D+Q mice (n=5 each), not analysed by RNA-seq in the paper.
planned_contrasts: D+Q vs vehicle at 14 d MOV (S3.5.p1; paper: ~2,000 DEGs, Fig. 6a)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one plantaris per mouse, independent animals
normalization: Partek E/M gene counts, minimum expression cutoff of 10 counts (S2.8.p1)
paper_results: ~2,000 DEGs D+Q vs vehicle; down: Ddit4, Cryab, TCA/ETC genes; up: Igf1, Fmod, Dcn, Mmp14, Adamts1, Plau, 7 ADAMTS members (S3.5.p1)
